sections.st: Bakery & Confectionery Trays Manufacturer India — Celebration Gift Trays, Bulk from Vapi
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures bakery and confectionery trays from our ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — food-grade thermoformed trays for large confectionery brands and bakery companies. Bulk confectionery packaging from Vapi for celebration and gifting tray programmes (Cadbury, Mondelez, Kinder Joy, Cornetto), premium bakery product presentation trays, and confectionery gift set inserts.

The tray geometry must hold each confectionery product in the exact gift-ready position, with the brand's product arrangement visible from the moment the box is opened.

sections.st: Three Problems Bakery & Confectionery Trays Buyers Face

strips.title: Celebration Gift Tray Layout — Brand Arrangement Not Preserved
strips.desc: Problem: Confectionery gift trays where cavity geometry does not hold each product in the brand's intended gift arrangement. Solution: Cavity geometry designed from every product in the collection in the brand's intended arrangement. Physical placement confirmed on prototype.

strips.title: Food-Grade Documentation Gap — FMCG Brand Supplier Qualification
strips.desc: Problem: Large confectionery brands require food-grade material documentation per batch. Solution: Food-grade PP and APET with food contact certification per production batch from our Vapi facility.

strips.title: Seasonal Volume Consistency — Same Tray Specification Every Gifting Season
strips.desc: Problem: Confectionery seasonal gift tray programmes require identical specification across seasons. Solution: Tooling held in-house at Vapi permanently — same food-grade PP grade, same ISO 9001:2015 documentation, same cavity geometry every seasonal run.

sections.st: Bakery & Confectionery Trays — Key Design Requirements

strips.title: Confectionery Item Layout — Brand Gift Arrangement Preserved
strips.desc: The confectionery item layout is confirmed from the brand's gift arrangement specification before cavity design. The tray cannot be produced until the brand's intended gift arrangement has been confirmed on a physical prototype.

strips.title: Food-Grade PP for All Confectionery Tray Applications
strips.desc: Food-grade PP is the standard material — certified for food contact, resistant to confectionery oils and fats, maintained flat under gift box stack loads. Food-grade APET or PETG for premium transparent gift trays.

strips.title: Moisture and Oil Resistance — Confectionery Product Compatibility
strips.desc: Confectionery products contain oils and fats. Food-grade PP has excellent chemical resistance to food oils and fats. Material compatibility confirmed from the confectionery product composition at brief stage.

strips.title: Gift Box Compatibility — Tray Dimensions to Box Interior
strips.desc: Celebration gift tray dimensions designed to the specific gift box interior. Products at the correct height for the gift box opening presentation.

faqs.q: What bakery and confectionery trays does Trizen manufacture?
faqs.a: Food-grade thermoformed celebration and gift trays for confectionery brands (Cadbury, Mondelez, Kinder Joy, Cornetto), premium bakery gift packaging inserts, seasonal gift collections, corporate gifting trays, and bulk confectionery supply trays. Food-grade PP and APET. ISO 9001:2015. Bulk confectionery packaging from Vapi, Gujarat.

faqs.q: What are celebration gift trays for confectionery brands?
faqs.a: Celebration gift trays hold each confectionery product in its defined cavity position — the brand's intended gift arrangement for Diwali, Christmas, Eid, and corporate gifting occasions. The tray is the brand's gifting moment presentation platform.

faqs.q: What is the Kinder Joy/Cornetto nachos and dip tray format?
faqs.a: A multi-cavity food-grade PP tray with nachos portion section and a dip cup cavity — designed for the nachos-and-dip gifting format. Food contact certified PP, moisture-resistant.
Food-grade PP (primary — all confectionery trays), food-grade APET (premium transparent gift trays), PETG (luxury confectionery gift packaging). Food-grade CoA per batch.

faqs.q: Why source confectionery trays from Vapi, Gujarat?
